title: M3-PG header
description: A plain white sticky header on a 4-column grid: a semibold wordmark in the first column, five nav links spread evenly over the middle two, a language code at the right. As the page scrolls the first 120px, the wordmark fades into a short, larger mark and the bar settles from 96px to 80px; nav links underline on hover. Phones get a thin three-line menu that opens a full-width list.
notes: sticky: put it first, directly inside the page wrapper
the wordmark-to-mark swap is a CSS scroll-driven animation; browsers without it keep the wordmark
name: m3-pg-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the full wordmark shown at the top of the page

props.name: mark
props.description: the short mark that replaces it once the page scrolls

props.name: links
props.description: the main links (five fit the desktop row)

props.name: language
props.description: the language switch at the right, e.g. { label: "DE", href: "/de/" }

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader label of the phone menu button
